system.description:
Wit; 6 Pierce; Long (150 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Two-hander: needs both hands free. Take Aim: an Interact Action spent aiming gives your next Strike with it Minor Advantage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.141
